app.tagline: Replay analyzer for World of Tanks and Mir Tankov
upload.drop: Drop a .wotreplay or .mtreplay here, or click to browse
upload.local: Parsed on your computer. Nothing is uploaded.
report.partial: Partially supported version: positions, shots, damage and results are read. Kills are rebuilt from the results (time within half a second), and hits on tanks the recorder could not see are missing, so some numbers are less reliable here.
col.name: Player
adv.title: Beyond classic stats
adv.sub: Weighted by who you were fighting and by how the battle stood
adv.dpm.tip: Damage ÷ minutes you were alive. Classic trackers use damage per battle.
adv.threat.tip: Each hit counts more when the target was dangerous: its own damage per minute vs the enemy team's median (1.0 = average target, capped 0.25–3).
adv.onthreats.tip: Share of your damage that went to enemies out-damaging the enemy median.
adv.impact.tip: Sum of the change in your team's win probability caused by your hits. Win probability v0 = remaining HP and tank count (initial model, will be calibrated).
adv.cleanup.tip: Share of your damage dealt after your team was already ≥ 90% to win.
viz.wp.sub: your team's chance over battle time (v0, uncalibrated)
viz.wp.aria: Line chart of your team's win probability over battle time with kill markers
viz.impact.sub: win-probability points each hit moved, and the running total
viz.impact.aria: Bars of win probability change per hit with cumulative line
viz.targets.sub: bar = raw damage, notch = weighted by how dangerous the target was
viz.targets.aria: Bar chart of damage by target
fb.note: Votes stay in this browser; nothing is uploaded. Copy them to send to us.
viz.cmp.sub: the same measure for all players
viz.cmp.aria: Bar chart comparing the selected measure across all players
viz.cmp.note: Dashed bars with ~ are partial: the replay only records hits that happened where the recorder could see, so we saw under 75% of that player's damage. Win-probability swing for others is measured from their own team's side.
fb.note.cloud: Votes are anonymous: only the metric ids and 👍/👎 are sent, never your replay or names.
fb.fail: Couldn't reach the server; use Copy instead.
err.crash: Something went wrong showing this page.
adv.bold.tip: Of the moments you could have fought (visible enemy within 220 m, game still open, gun probably ready), how many you took by firing within 5 s. High = you take chances; low = you sit them out. Not a verdict: some roles should wait.
gl.impact.how: We rebuild your team's win chance every second from the tanks alive and their HP (model v0). For each of your hits we take the win chance just after minus just before, and add them up, in percentage points.
gl.impact.mean: Positive means your hits moved the game your team's way. It rewards damage that came when the result was open. The model is uncalibrated, so use it to compare players within one battle, not across battles.
gl.threat.how: Each of your hits counts as damage × target weight. The weight is the target's damage per minute divided by the enemy team's median, limited to 0.25–3. Summed over all your hits.
gl.threat.mean: Above your raw damage means you hit the dangerous players; below means much of it went on weak ones. ×1.00 is an average target.
gl.onthreats.how: Share of your damage that landed on enemies with weight 1.0 or higher (they out-damaged the enemy median).
gl.onthreats.mean: High means your shots went to the tanks that hurt your team most.
gl.cleanup.how: Share of your damage dealt while your team's win chance was already 90% or more.
gl.cleanup.mean: High means a lot of your damage came after the result was mostly decided. Classic stats count it in full; we show it separately.
gl.dpm.how: Damage dealt ÷ minutes you were alive (at least 10 seconds). Lifetime comes from the battle results.
gl.dpm.mean: Fair for short and long lives alike. Classic trackers use damage per battle, which hides how quickly you worked.
gl.bold.how: We check every second you were alive and visible. An opening is a second with an enemy visible within 220 m, the game still open (your team below 90% to win) and your gun probably ready (estimated from your own fastest shot cycle). Openings close together form one episode. Initiative = episodes where you fired within 5 s ÷ all episodes. Needs at least 3 episodes.
gl.bold.mean: High means you take chances when they exist; low means you wait them out. Neither is wrong on its own: some roles should wait. Read it together with how the chances went.
gl.paid.how: For each chance you took we look from its start to 5 s after its end. It paid off if the damage you dealt there (each hit × target weight) was at least what you lost, or you got a kill. Shown as a share of the chances you took; needs at least 3.
gl.paid.mean: High means that when you commit, you win the exchange.
gl.costly.how: A taken chance is costly if, in that window, you lost at least 10% of your max HP, dealt less (target-weighted) than you lost, and got no kill. Shown as a share of the chances you took; needs at least 3.
gl.costly.mean: High means you often commit into exchanges you lose. The fix is usually the moment (reload, cover, support), not fighting less.
gl.style.how: Safe: initiative under 35%. Bold and costly: initiative 35% or more and 40% or more of taken chances were costly. Bold and rewarded: initiative 60% or more, under 40% costly and 50% or more paid off. Anything else: balanced.
gl.style.mean: A description of how you played this battle, not a grade. The thresholds are first guesses and will be recalibrated on real battles.
gl.acc.how: Hits ÷ shots from the battle results.
gl.acc.mean: Low accuracy costs damage. Big or close targets inflate it, so compare with similar tanks.
gl.pen.how: Penetrating hits ÷ hits from the battle results.
gl.pen.mean: Low means many shots met armour. Look at ammo choice and aiming points.
gl.life.how: Your time alive ÷ battle length, both from the battle results.
gl.life.mean: 100% means you survived to the end. Surviving is not a goal by itself: read it next to damage and Impact.
player.timeline: Timeline: win chance curve and kills
player.nomap: Grid only: map image arrives with game data
coach.title: Coach
coach.sub: Moments worth a look, with what they cost
coach.none: No moments above the confidence bar in this battle ({n} checks run). That is a result, not a gap: the detectors are few and still growing.
coach.earlyHpDump.title: Lost {pct}% of your HP in the first two minutes
coach.earlyHpDump.body: {hp} HP went to {by} enemy tank(s) before 2:00.
coach.earlyHpDump.fix: Open from a safer spot and let the first shots come to you: the opening exchange rarely decides the game.
coach.isolatedUnderFire.title: Alone under fire
coach.isolatedUnderFire.body: Your nearest ally was {dist} m away, {enemies} enemies were in view and you took {hp} HP.
coach.isolatedUnderFire.fix: Fall back toward your team before the fight, or wait until an ally is within about 120 m.
coach.badTrade.title: Lost the exchange
coach.badTrade.body: You started it, dealt {dealt} and took {got}.
coach.badTrade.fix: Start exchanges from cover or with an ally covering, and leave once the trade turns against you.
coach.wonTrade.title: Won the exchange
coach.wonTrade.fix: This is the pattern to repeat.
coach.idleWithTargets.title: Idle with enemies in view
coach.idleWithTargets.body: {secs} s without a shot or real movement while an enemy was visible nearby. At your own average pace that is about {dmg} damage.
coach.idleWithTargets.fix: Take a spot where you can shoot, or move to where the fight is.
coach.deathRecap.title: How you died
coach.deathRecap.body: In the last {secs} s you lost {lost} HP from {sources} source(s), most from {main} ({mainHp}). Killed by {killer}.
coach.deathRecap.fix: Look at where you stood in the seconds before: who could see you and from where.
coach.survivedUnusedHp.title: Survived with HP to spare
coach.survivedUnusedHp.body: Your team lost; you finished with {hp} HP and dealt {dealt} damage.
coach.survivedUnusedHp.fix: When the game is slipping, trade HP for damage earlier: unused HP wins nothing.
map.title: Map image for {name}
map.help: Optional. Use the minimap picture and the arena XML from your own game files. They stay on this device and are never uploaded.
map.noxml: No boundingBox found in that file; type the four numbers (metres).
map.invalid: Choose an image and enter valid bounds (x0 < x1, z0 < z1).
map.savefail: Could not save in this browser.
curve.aria: Running metric over the battle, synced with the replay
curve.partial: Hits seen for this player cover {p}% of their official damage, so the curve ends low.
curve.wp.how: Team win probability (v0). Rises when your side trades well. Findings are marked with dashed lines.
curve.dmg.how: Damage dealt to enemies so far, summed from observed hits. Flat stretches are time without hitting anything.
curve.dpm.how: Damage so far ÷ minutes of battle (or of life, once destroyed). Shows if you are ahead of or behind your usual pace now.
curve.hit.how: Damaging hits ÷ shots so far (needs 3 shots). Shots that bounce or miss count as not damaging, so this is below the official accuracy. It settles as shots pile up.
mp.aria: Heatmap of the battle on the map
mp.legend: Darkest cell = {max} · cell {cell} m · total {total}. Tap a cell to read it.
mp.agg: Win rate by spawn side and other all-battle statistics need many battles. They appear here once opt-in aggregates exist; this page shows only the battles you load.
mp.l.presence.how: Each second a tank is alive adds one second to the map cell it stands in. Enemies count only where we actually saw them.
mp.l.presence.mean: Where fights and lanes really are, and where your team spent its time.
mp.l.dmgdealt.how: Each damaging hit adds its damage to the cell where the target stood.
mp.l.dmgdealt.mean: Where damage is won. Compare your hot cells with the team's.
mp.l.dmgrecv.how: Each damaging hit adds its damage to the cell where the victim stood.
mp.l.dmgrecv.mean: Where tanks get hurt. Bright cells on your own path are places to avoid or to approach differently.
mp.l.deaths.how: Each destroyed tank adds 1 to the cell where it died.
mp.l.deaths.mean: Positions that cost lives. Repeated deaths in one spot suggest a trap.
mp.l.routes.how: Presence limited to the first 60 seconds of the battle.
mp.l.routes.mean: Which lanes each side takes at the start.
mp.l.spots.how: The first time an enemy was spotted, we add 1 to the cell where it stood.
mp.l.spots.mean: Where enemies get found. Bright cells on the way to your position are where you are first seen.
mp.l.tracers.how: One line per shot: from where the shooter stood when firing to where the shell ended (hit, ricochet or ground). Blue = your team, red = enemy. We see an end point for about three quarters of shots.
mp.l.tracers.mean: Which lanes are shot across, from where, and how far. Many lines crossing your position mean a hot firing lane. Long lines from one spot show a sniping position.
mp.tracers.legend: {n} shots with a known end point. Blue = your team, red = enemy.
